Summary of a bayesnechurdlefit

Source: R/bayesnechurdlefit-methods.R
summary.bayesnechurdlefit.Rd

Summary of a bayesnechurdlefit

# S3 method for class 'bayesnechurdlefit'
summary(object, ..., ecx = FALSE, ecx_vals = c(10, 50, 90))

Arguments

object

An object of class bayesnechurdlefit.

...

Passed to nec and ecx for each component, so that xform in particular applies to every estimate in the table.

ecx

Should ECx estimates be included? Defaults to FALSE.

ecx_vals

The ECx levels to report.

Value

An object of class hurdlesummary.

Details

The no-effect estimate is reported for all three endpoints and labelled by type: NEC where the component's model set is entirely threshold models, NSEC where it is entirely smooth ones, and N(S)EC where it is a mixture (Fisher et al. 2023). The combined estimate is the smaller of the two component estimates per posterior draw, so it is a pure NEC only where both components are; see nec.bayesnechurdlefit.

References

Fisher R, Fox DR, Negri AP, van Dam J, Flores F, Koppel D (2023). Methods for estimating no-effect toxicity concentrations in ecotoxicology. Integrated Environmental Assessment and Management. doi: 10.1002/ieam.4809.
